analysis.title: Blue Portrait Conversational Landing Page
analysis.notes: A full-screen portrait photograph dominates the composition, with centered oversized white messaging layered over the subject and a darkened lower gradient for legibility. The restrained pill-shaped navigation and rounded download buttons create a polished, approachable product-landing direction.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a full-bleed editorial lifestyle photograph for a modern mobile app landing page: a smiling young woman with auburn hair holds a pale green smartphone close to the camera, wearing a chunky lavender knit sweater, against a clear muted blue sky. Use intimate low-angle framing, warm natural sunlight, shallow depth of field, rich skin texture, and a candid joyful expression. Leave clean negative space near the center for white headline typography, with a subtle darkening gradient toward the bottom. No logos, brands, readable text, or interface elements.
